{{Quote|Nenn is the senior Master of the Theran Listeners&mdash;as close as we have to a leader.|[[Taru Durn]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>}}
The '''Master of the Theran Listeners''' was the senior [[Listener-Master]] and the unofficial leader of the [[Theran Listener]]s, a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] organization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. In [[44 ABY]], the Master of the Theran Listeners was [[Nenn]]. In that year, the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]] arrived on Nam Chorios and took control of Nenn; however, when she tried to use Nenn's body to [[Operation Shieldfall|combat]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Nenn committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction" />
